professionalSummary: Machine Learning Engineer specializing in model development, optimization, and edge AI deployment. Reduced mT5 SLM model size 5x (from 500MB to 100MB) via pruning, 8-bit LoRA, and INT8 quantization. Following computer vision experience, currently focusing on Natural Language Processing (NLP). Co-authored a research paper published in El-Cezeri Journal (2026). Top 10 finalist at the Pupilica AI Hackathon.
